# couchbase-capella-aidp_workflow_run (Data Source)

Retrieves a single AI Data Plane workflow run by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "couchbase-capella-aidp_workflow_run" "example" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  project_id      = var.project_id
  cluster_id      = var.cluster_id
  workflow_id     = var.workflow_id
  id              = var.run_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String)
- `id` (String) Workflow run identifier.
- `organization_id` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `workflow_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `status` (String)
